Needs changes before merge.

The shared menu metrics cover the requested drawers. The parser clamps the four new tokens. The new dropdown tests and the browser refusal tests pass.

Local checks:

- Read the rules from current upstream main, `983f527bd7aab4f856666e62f0c06f381bc57474`.
- The trial merge with that main failed in eight files. I aborted the merge. All build and test results below apply to the unchanged PR head, not a merged tree.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selected the UI library and four integration suites.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- UI library: 778 passed, one failed, five ignored. A second full run gave the same result.
- `headless_run_succeeds`: passed when run alone. The full suite could not select a graphics adapter. This is a local test limitation, not a confirmed defect in this patch.
- `boundary`: three passed. `boundary_picks`: six passed. `sinker_setup`: one passed. `theme_files`: 16 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The full library runs reported this error:

```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter: software adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found; noop support not compiled in, vulkan support not compiled in, metal found no adapters, dx12 support not compiled in, gl support not compiled in, webgpu support not compiled in; hardware adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found; noop support not compiled in, vulkan support not compiled in, metal found no adapters, dx12 support not compiled in, gl support not compiled in, webgpu support not compiled in
```

Required before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:1185`: Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. Show the default menu and a custom theme in a narrow window. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, then link them in the body.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme.rs:85`: Resolve the conflicts at merge time, after parent #1687. Keep the current upstream theme fields and icon rendering. Then run the selected tests and clippy on the merged tree. The conflicting files are `assets/themes/theme.json.example`, `panes.rs`, `recent_drop.rs`, `tests.rs`, `theme.rs`, `theme/tables.rs`, `theme_files.rs`, and `theme_files/overlay.rs`. The Rust paths are under `crates/ui/src/egui_app/`.

This patch does not change posted G-code, machining geometry, gouge checks, collision checks, or stock simulation. It changes no goldens against its stack parent. No mutation checks ran in this review. No code or evidence was committed. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: No findings fixed. Stopped at the required same-logic conflict check.

The merge of upstream/main conflicts in crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs, in ribbon's operation dropdown label position (PR line 1185). The PR uses r.left_center() + Vec2::new(g.pad_x, 0.0). Main uses r.left_center() + Vec2::new(text_x, 0.0), with text_x changing from 8 to 28 when an operation icon is rendered. Both sides changed the same positioning logic. Preserving theme padding and icon clearance requires a logic decision, so I aborted the merge as instructed.

Eight files conflicted. Parent #1687 is still open. No files were committed or pushed. The screenshot finding remains open. No pins, mutation checks, gate, or clippy ran because the merge was aborted.

Head remains 1e1c92f54d6a2c022326c2d9a5cf710015e6ff31. Please re-review this blocking hunk before another author-side fix attempt.

Needs changes before merge.

This review checks the later conflict report on the same head. Both earlier findings remain open.

Local checks:

- I read the current rules from upstream main, `7bcc13a4b71df50648207acb05a4ea9c54ab258d`.
- I fetched the PR into `.claude/worktrees/review-2457` and attempted a trial merge with that main.
- The merge failed in eight files. I read the operation-label conflict and aborted the merge.
- No new build, test, clippy, or mutation checks ran. The head and the screenshot evidence did not change. No merged tree exists to test.
- The earlier review reports local build and clippy passes on this head. Its full UI suite had a graphics-adapter failure. The isolated test passed. Those are earlier results, not new results from this review.

Required before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:1185`: Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. Show the default menu and a custom theme in a narrow window. The body still has no screenshots. Store them only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:1185`: Resolve the conflicts at merge time, after parent #1687. Main draws a 16-point operation icon between row offsets 4 and 20. Main puts its label at offset 28. This PR puts the label at `g.pad_x`, which defaults to 8. Keeping that label position with main's icon would cause overlap. Keep the icon and derive its clearance and label spacing from the shared menu metrics. Keep theme padding when no icon is present. Add coverage with icons loaded, with default and custom padding. Then run the selected UI tests and clippy on the merged tree. Keep main's newer theme fields and accessibility registration.

The conflicting files are `assets/themes/theme.json.example` and these files under `crates/ui/src/egui_app/`: `panes.rs`, `recent_drop.rs`, `tests.rs`, `theme.rs`, `theme/tables.rs`, `theme_files.rs`, and `theme_files/overlay.rs`.

The author's decision to abort this same-logic conflict was correct. This review identifies the required combined behavior; it does not resolve the conflict. Parent #1687 remains open. Refresh this branch only when it is next in the merge batch, or with an author review fix.

This patch changes UI layout. It does not change posted G-code, machining geometry, gouge checks, collision checks, or stock simulation. It changes no goldens against its stack parent. No GitHub runner was used. No code or evidence was committed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

I attempted to merge upstream/main at 7bcc13a4b71df50648207acb05a4ea9c54ab258d. Eight files had conflicts.

The blocking hunk is in crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs, in ribbon, at the operation dropdown label position. The PR uses r.left_center() + Vec2::new(g.pad_x, 0.0). Main uses r.left_center() + Vec2::new(text_x, 0.0). Main sets text_x to 28 when it draws an operation icon, and to 8 otherwise. Both sides changed the same label-position logic.

The latest review specifies the combined behavior. However, the current author-fix instructions require a stop when both sides change the same logic. I aborted the merge. No files were committed or pushed. The screenshot finding and the icon-spacing finding remain open. No pins, mutation checks, gate, or clippy ran.

The head remains 1e1c92f54d6a2c022326c2d9a5cf710015e6ff31. Please re-review the blocking hunk and provide explicit authorization to resolve this same-logic conflict before the next fix attempt.

   - The default theme gives main's 4 / 16 / 28 layout.
   - Main's newer theme fields, module split and Examples row stay. The four menu tokens are added to them.
   - No snapshot PNG changed. The hand-resolved files are listed in the PR body and in `docs/decisions/2065-theme-dropdown-tokens-uma.md`.

New pins in commit `c972e226d`:

- `op_dropdown_icon_and_label_follow_menu_metrics`
- `dropdown_icon_clearance_derives_from_padding`

Note: parent #1687 is still open. This branch contains its commits. The labels are not changed. This refresh is class DELTA and needs a delta review.

**Verdict: no blockers**

Full review of the whole diff against `main`, which includes the content of parent PR #1687 (commits `c07d8ac75`..`b706db9c7`). Read from the diff. Not built.

## Checks

1. **Remerge-diff of `00b38e44f` (class DELTA).**
   - `panes.rs` (operation section drop, ~1280-1300): main's kind icon stays. The icon inset, size and label x come from `DropGeom::clip_inset_x`, `icon_px` and `icon_text_x`. A row without an icon keeps `pad_x`. At the default tokens (`row_height` 20, `menu_pad_x` 8) the values are 4 / 16 / 28, which is main's layout. The View checkbox keeps 14 / 10.
   - `theme.rs`, `theme/clamp.rs`, `theme/tables.rs`, `theme_files.rs`, `theme_files/names.rs`, `theme_files/overlay.rs`, `theme.json.example`: main's module split and newer fields (`ribbon_ink`, `font_label_min`, the ribbon and tree tokens, `RADIUS_WINDOW`) are kept. The four menu tokens are added to the struct, both tables, both exhaustive destructurings, `geom_legal`, the vocabulary and the example. Nothing from main is lost.
   - `recent_drop.rs`: main's Examples row is kept with the fitted width and left edge.
   - `tests.rs`: the PR side's machine-door test body is gone, but `main` had already replaced it with the workspace-tab test. The resolution takes main's test. Both module lists are kept.
   - A trial merge (`git merge-tree`) with the current `main` `e2ed62d0b` is clean. The `conflicts` label is stale.
2. **Theme tokens.** Each token is clamped at parse time and again in `DropGeom::from_tokens`. `clamp::range` maps a non-finite value to the low bound. `icon_px` uses `clamp(8.0, row_h.min(24.0))`; `row_h` is at least 12, so the clamp cannot panic. `fit_width` handles non-finite and negative widths. No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in production code. `pal.dropdown()` is a few float operations for each frame, which is acceptable. No new layer edge. The #1687 part changes menu state only; a click still goes through the command queue.
3. **Tests.** The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` goes from 1270 to 1279 (+9: 3 dropdown_theme, 2 dropdown_icon_rows, 2 browser_file_menus, 2 theme_files/dropdown). No test is deleted or ignored. No snapshot PNG changes. `op_dropdown_icon_and_label_follow_menu_metrics` measures the painted icon and label in the real shell, with the default and a custom padding. It is a meaningful pin of the hand resolution.
4. **Body and files.** The screenshots are present (four before/after pairs). All eight images load (HTTP 200). They show no private path or user name. The body has `Changelog:`, `Fixes #2065`, the pinning tests and a gate on the final head. The decision file has the required heading and parts.
5. **UI text.** The new strings are plain English.

## Findings of the last review on #1687 (head `b706db9c7`)

| Finding | Applies to what this PR merges | Blocker here |
|---|---|---|
| Blocker: no before/after screenshots | The rows are the same. The #1687 body now has the four browser-mode screenshots (added after that review). | No |
| Note: a disabled Fixtures row can paint the hover fill; the Theme menu checks `&& live` | Yes, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/fixture_menu.rs:114` against `crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme_drop.rs:121`. In egui 0.36 `hovered()` is false for a disabled widget, so no wrong fill is expected. The two rules still differ. | No |
| Note: `tests/structural.rs` is past 400 lines | Yes, 584 lines (main 581, +3 here). | No |
| Note: the known-issue line of #1431 goes on the release branch | Yes, no change here. | No |

## Non-blocking findings

- **Stack order.** The stacking rule merges the parent first. #1687 is still a draft with `needs-rework`, and its body has `Fixes #1431`. This PR has only `Fixes #2065`. If this PR merges first, #1687's content lands on `main`, but #1431 may not close. Recommended: re-check #1687 (its screenshot blocker is answered) and merge it first. Alternatively, close #1431 by hand with the merge commit after this PR merges.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme.rs` grows from 428 to 447 lines, and `panes.rs` was already past 400 lines. Both were over the limit on `main`.
- `dropdown_icon_clearance_derives_from_padding` repeats the formula of `from_tokens`. It is a weak pin. The harness test above carries the real proof.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:1401`: in a window narrower than the longest machine label, `fit_width` cuts the label. The doc comment of `machine_menu_width` says that text is never cut. The decision file accepts this, but the doc comment could say it.
- The "after" screenshot with the default theme moves the operation menu left to stay in the window. This is the intended fit, not a change of the default row layout.
